name: qfd_tile_nk_rp2_45_a2-lc45-COMMIT
purpose: HELD45-clock structural successor to measured unqualified25-entry spread268ps: eight per-LSL TX roots, five face roots, ten bank-pair roots, two RQR roots, residual core root,19 unchanged hard entries. Actual endpoint/exclusive-comb fences and per-root area checks; all64MAC/10mappedROM/8closedLSL/node retained; normal data calendar unchanged. Same actual a2 outline and hard geometry; all incident pins assigned on .012+.048k tracks.
